sourceRef: Sage Payroll Tax Pocket Guide 2025-2026 s7.12.2 (X = A x B - C); https://www.sars.gov.za/wp-content/uploads/Ops/Guides/PAYE-GEN-01-G21-Guide-for-Employers-iro-Employees-Tax-for-2027-External-Guide.pdf (s11F 27.5% of remuneration)
notes: Salary R20 000 = RFI (B); fund member category factor 0.40 (A); employee contribution 1 500 (C, 4001). X = 0.40 x 20 000 - 1 500 = 6 500 (non-cash fringe, deemed contributed by the employee). Remuneration 26 500; contributions 1 500 + 6 500 = 8 000 exceed 27.5% x 26 500 = 7 287.50, so the cap binds; taxable 26 500 - 7 287.50 = 19 212.50, x 12 = 230 550, 18% - 17 820 = 23 679 / 12 = 1 973.25. Net 20 000 - 1 500 - 1 973.25 - 177.12 = 16 349.63. UNVERIFIED: the para 12D formula is read from Sage’s pocket guide, not a SARS 2027 page.
